How much did I make?

By the end of the month, I had earned over $500.

What did I spend it on?

I spent it on clearing my pending bills. If some of you remember vividly when I made my thanksgiving tweet then. For me, it wasn't just about the money. It was proof that I could build a skill, stay consistent, and create an income stream online.
